benchmark_answers.answer: SEO/GEO uses Core-owned identity/session/approval with domain tools for crawl, search, competitor, keyword, content, publishing, and rank/LLM-answer sensing; disagreement is preserved across `getuai-seo`, `rankncompare`, and `growth-engine-legacy`.

Content runs ideation -> outline -> draft -> edit/review -> publish/send -> post-publish measurement, with prompt variables, recipient schema, SMTP test, storage contracts, retrieval grounding, and human review marked load-bearing.

Ads follows campaign feed -> bidding/budget/targeting -> reporting -> attribution -> optimization, separating platform-bound SDK/mutations from agnostic envelopes, attribution events, metrics, pacing, anomaly, and kill criteria.

Social decomposes listen, post, schedule, engage, monitor; OpenClaw Gateway is treated as closest abstraction, with per-platform adapters, quota/credit monitoring, and moderation before public automation.
Q5 keeps 9 SEO/GEO skill rows with all 8 columns and explicitly retains `sitemap-robots-generator`, preserving static-publisher evidence and row-count margin above the >=8 threshold.

Q6 keeps content skills for prompt templates, personalized draft, recipient import, SMTP send/review, cited copy, rank summary, media composition, and summarization/transcription, mapped to drift, hallucination, register, and grounding mitigations.
Q7 keeps 9 Ads skill rows with all 8 columns and explicitly retains `composite-campaign-build`, preserving partial-failure and kill-criteria evidence above the >=8 threshold.
Q8 keeps social skills across Reddit, YouTube, X, OpenClaw inbox, Slack actions, and channel gating, with platform differences and API-change failures parameterized explicitly.
Q9 preserves five SEO/GEO cognition models with decision, trigger, worked-here, failed-here, and anti-pattern evidence.
Q10 preserves five content cognition frames with worked/failed evidence and explicit hooks to Q2 architecture and Q6 skills.
Q11 preserves five ads cognition models with worked/failed evidence, platform-change break conditions, and kill-vs-scale criteria.
Q12 preserves five social cognition models with per-platform evidence and explicit automation visibility cost.

Q13 preserves shared foundations and the decision rule: share tenant trust, credentials, schedules, ledgers, observability, LLM routing, and approvals; isolate domain schemas, APIs, ranking logic, tone, and kill criteria.
Q14 preserves the six-row Day-1 to Month-3 build sequence with dependencies, done criteria, next triggers, Q1-Q13 hooks, and failure-informed deferrals.
Q15 preserves the failure-mode artifact with structural cause, early symptom, prophylactic, recurrence count, affected domains, evidence pairs, and growth-engine-legacy lessons.
